_meta.purpose: Niagara Parks paid parking lots missing from the business list. Identified on OpenStreetMap (17 November 2026) by name and position along the Niagara Parkway; OpenStreetMap does not record their operator. Rapidsview is a cluster of unnamed fee lots, entered as one point.
_meta.confidence: Falls Parking Lot, Falls Overflow and NPC Butterfly Parking are named on the map; Rapidsview and the Dufferin Islands lot are inferred from position and should be checked.
_meta.pull: 'pull' multiplies a lot's draw so the model's split between the Falls lots and Rapidsview matches the measured vehicles (2000-2004 average: Falls 414,208, Rapids View 58,629, ratio 7.1 to 1; data/niagara_parks_parking_history.json). With equal pull the model gave Falls (Lot A + Overflow) $8.2M against Rapidsview $12.0M (0.69 to 1); the split moves with the pull ratio to the power 1.3 to 1.7, so Falls 2.17 and Rapidsview 0.8. Dufferin Islands and Butterfly lots were not counted and keep 1.
